top_signals.title: Statement by President von der Leyen, Executive Vice-President Mînzatu, and Commissioner Lahbib ahead of European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 01 Aug 2026 Ahead of European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day on 2 August, Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission, Roxana Mînzatu, Executive Vice-President for Social Rights and Skills, Quality Jobs and Preparedness, and Hadja Lahbib Commissioner for Equality, Preparedness and Crisis Management, issued the following statement…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
